patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Brevo and Flodesk share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Brevo only if your buying job matches “Multi-channel email marketing with send-based pricing, a generous free plan, and CRM-lite ” rather than Flodesk's shape. Choose Flodesk only if your buying job matches “Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everythin” rather than Brevo's shape. Workflow advantage: Brevo leans ecommerce-email; Flodesk leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Brevo and Flodesk share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Brevo is Multi-channel email marketing with send-based pricing, a generous free plan, and CRM-lite tools — formerly Sendinblue.; Flodesk is Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everything plans..
- Company-size focus: Brevo (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Flodesk (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Brevo-leaning ecommerce-email vs Flodesk-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Brevo — Free plan daily send cap (300/day) constrains frequent campaigners; Flodesk — Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier.

Limitations — Brevo: Free plan daily send cap (300/day) constrains frequent campaigners; Advanced automation and A/B depth concentrate on Standard+; Flodesk: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier; Subscriber-tier pricing replaced legacy flat unlimited for new members.

Poor-fit cases: Brevo is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (300/day) constrains frequent campaigners · Flodesk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier · Avoid Brevo if you actually need Flodesk's motion (Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro /)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
